state.seed_assertion: Controllers must conduct a data protection impact assessment before processing when the processing is likely to result in high risk to rights and freedoms, particularly when using new technologies and considering the nature, scope, context and purposes of the processing.

sentences.1: Organizations should consult individuals and other relevant stakeholders when carrying out a DPIA.
sentences.2: Carrying out a DPIA is not a one-time exercise.
sentences.3: A controller shall carry out a review to assess if processing is performed in accordance with the data protection impact assessment at least when there is a change of the risk represented by processing operations.
sentences.4: Where necessary, the controller shall carry out a review to assess if processing is performed in accordance with the data protection impact assessment at least when there is a change of the risk represented by processing operations.
sentences.5: In some cases we may advise you not to carry out the processing because we consider it would be in breach of the GDPR.
sentences.6: We carry out a new DPIA if there is a change to the nature, scope, context or purposes of our processing.
sentences.7: Recital 91 says innovative technology concerns new developments in technological knowledge in the world at large, rather than technology that is new to you, and its use can trigger the need to carry out a DPIA.
sentences.8: A processor may be asked to carry out a DPIA on behalf of the controller, but the controller remains responsible for the DPIA.
